text: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًا
translation: By the [winds] scattering [dust], dispersing [it]

text: فَٱلْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًا
translation: And the [clouds] carrying a load [of water]

text: فَٱلْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًا
translation: And the ships sailing with ease

text: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ أَمْرًا
translation: And the [angels] apportioning [each] matter,

text: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ
translation: Indeed, what you are promised is true.

text: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
translation: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.

text: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
translation: By the heaven containing pathways,1

text: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ
translation: Indeed, you are in differing speech.1

text: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
translation: Deluded away from it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is he who is deluded.

text: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
translation: Destroyed are the misinformers1

text: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ
translation: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.

text: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"

text: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
translation: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire.

text: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
translation: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."

text: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,

text: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
translation: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.

text: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
translation: They used to sleep but little of the night,1

text: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
translation: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,

text: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
translation: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.

text: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
translation: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]

text: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
translation: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?

text: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
translation: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.

text: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
translation: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.

text: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
translation: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham?1 -

text: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
translation: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace; [you are] a people unknown."

text: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
translation: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf.

text: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
translation: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"

text: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
translation: And he felt from them apprehension.1 They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.

text: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
translation: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"

text: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."

text: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

text: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
translation: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals1

text: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ
translation: To send down upon them stones of clay,

text: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
translation: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."

text: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation: So We brought out whoever was in them [i.e., the cities] of the believers.

text: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
translation: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.1

text: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
translation: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.

text: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.1

text: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
translation: But he turned away with his supporters and said, "A magician or a madman."

text: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
translation: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.

text: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
translation: And in ʿAad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.1

text: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
translation: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.

text: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
translation: And in Thamūd, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."

text: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
translation: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.

text: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
translation: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.

text: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ
translation: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.

text: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
translation: And the heaven We constructed with strength,1 and indeed, We are [its] expander.

text: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَـٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَـٰهِدُونَ
translation: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.

text: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
translation: And of all things We created two mates [i.e., counterparts]; perhaps you will remember.

text: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation: So flee to Allāh.1 Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

text: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation: And do not make [as equal] with Allāh another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

text: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
translation: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."

text: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
translation: Did they suggest it to them?1 Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.

text: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ
translation: So leave them, [O Muḥammad], for you are not to be blamed.

text: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.

text: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
translation: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

text: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
translation: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.

text: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
translation: Indeed, it is Allāh who is the [continual] Provider,1 the firm possessor of strength.

text: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَـٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
translation: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their companions [i.e., predecessors], so let them not impatiently urge Me.

text: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
translation: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
